summary: Draw board arrows through the arrow components

entries.summary: Draw each arrow's line, head and label through `BoardArrowPath`, `BoardArrowhead` and `BoardArrowLabel` from `platejs/board/react`, so an arrow follows a dragged or resized shape without a render. `board-styles` exports the head as `ARROW_HEAD`, which the static arrow draws too.
migrationNotes: Copy the `board` item again with all its files, because `board-static` draws the head that `board-styles` exports as `ARROW_HEAD`.
`platejs/board/react` drops `useArrowPath`, so an arrow renderer of your own draws through `BoardArrowPath`, `BoardArrowhead` and `BoardArrowLabel` inside its `BoardShape`.
